title: CI Artifact Index v1
description: Canonical CI artifact index produced by the CI evidence orchestrator. Indexes every artifact produced or referenced by a CI run with its digest, classification, and release-gate relevance.

run_id.description: Stable identifier for the parent CI run.

artifact_id.description: Stable identifier for this artifact within the run.

artifact_kind.description: Artifact kind (e.g., ci_run, ci_verdict, ci_job, release_bundle, test_receipt, schema_validation, evidence_jsonl, manifest_json).

path.description: Relative path from repo root to the artifact.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the artifact content.

producer.description: Component or script that produced this artifact (e.g., 'ci_evidence_producer', 'package_release', 'pytest').

required_for_release_gate.description: True if this artifact is required for the release gate to close.

source_surface.description: Source surface that produced this artifact.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this artifact was indexed.

artifacts.description: List of indexed artifacts for this CI run.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this index was generated.
